entries.question: What does the audit trail record?
entries.answer: The audit log records who connected, what happened, and when each session ended, so every connection stays reviewable. Retention depends on your plan: 30 days on Starter, 1 year on Team, 3 years on Business, and custom retention on Enterprise.

entries.question: How do technicians use the admin console?
entries.answer: Technicians sign in to the web admin console, pick an enrolled device, and start an authorized session — screen viewing with responsive control, session quality visible at a glance, and the privacy curtain one click away. Session recording is available per plan, and everything lands in the audit log.

entries.question: Can sessions be recorded?
entries.answer: Yes. Session recording is optional on Starter and included on Team and Business; Enterprise sets its own policy. Recordings complement the audit log so reviews can see exactly what happened during a session.
